recipe_version.title: Vietnamese Turmeric Fish with Dill and Noodles
recipe_version.description: Chả cá–style catfish: bite-size pieces marinated in turmeric, ginger, shallot, and fish sauce, seared golden, then tossed with a big handful of dill and scallions wilted in the hot pan. Served over cool rice vermicelli with mint, chopped roasted cashews, red chile, and a bright lime nước chấm. No shrimp paste; cashews instead of peanuts.

ingredients.name: catfish fillets
ingredients.note: Finfish. Firm, mild, and holds together in the pan.
ingredients.preparation: patted dry and cut into 2-inch pieces

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: divided: 2 for the marinade, 1 for the nước chấm

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.note: divided: 1 1/2 tbsp marinade, 3 tbsp nước chấm. HARD CONTRACT: label lists only anchovy (fish), salt, and optionally water/sugar. No shrimp, crab, oyster, or other shellfish ingredient. This is not shrimp paste (mắm tôm), which is excluded.

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.note: divided: 1 tsp marinade, 2 tbsp (6 tsp) nước chấm

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: marinade; the fish sauce carries most of the salt

ingredients.name: neutral high-heat oil
ingredients.note: divided: 1 tbsp marinade, 2 tbsp sear, 1 tbsp for the dill. HARD CONTRACT: not peanut oil.

ingredients.name: fresh dill
ingredients.note: 2 large bunches. Dill is a main vegetable here, not a garnish.
ingredients.preparation: thick stems removed, cut into 2-inch sprigs (about 3 loosely packed cups)

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.preparation: cut into 2-inch lengths; white parts halved lengthwise

ingredients.name: roasted cashews
ingredients.note: HARD CONTRACT: plain cashews only, not a mixed-nut or trail-mix product. Replaces the traditional peanuts. Tree nut (cashew) — the HH001 cashew exception.

ingredients.name: fresh red chile
ingredients.preparation: thinly sliced; half for the nước chấm, half to garnish

steps.title: Marinate the fish
steps.body: Pat the catfish dry and cut into 2-inch pieces. In a bowl stir together 1 tbsp turmeric, the grated ginger, the minced shallot, 2 cloves of the garlic, 1 1/2 tbsp of the fish sauce, 1 tsp of the sugar, 1/4 tsp kosher salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, and 1 tbsp of the oil. Add the fish and turn gently to coat every piece yellow. Let it marinate at room temperature for 15 minutes while you do the next step (or refrigerate up to 2 hours). About 5 minutes.

steps.title: Boil water; prep herbs, cashews, and nước chấm
steps.body: Bring a large covered pot of water to a boil for the noodles. Cut the dill into 2-inch sprigs and the scallions into 2-inch lengths. Pick the mint leaves. Coarsely chop the cashews. Thinly slice the chile. Juice 2 limes (about 3 tbsp) and cut the third into wedges. For the nước chấm, stir 2 tbsp sugar into 1/2 cup warm water until dissolved, then add 3 tbsp fish sauce, the 3 tbsp lime juice, the last clove of minced garlic, and half the chile. Taste: it should be bright, salty-sweet-sour. The fish finishes its 15-minute marinade during this step. About 15 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.body: Boil the rice vermicelli according to the package, usually 3 to 5 minutes, until tender but springy. Drain, rinse under cold water until cool, shake very dry, and divide among 4 shallow bowls. About 6 minutes.

steps.title: Sear the turmeric fish
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high until shimmering. Add the fish in a single layer with space between pieces, scraping in any marinade. Cook without moving for 3 minutes, until the undersides are deep golden. Turn each piece gently with a thin spatula and cook 2 to 3 minutes more, until opaque all the way through and flaking at the edges (145 F). Move the fish to a plate. About 6 minutes.

steps.title: Wilt the dill and scallions
steps.body: Return the skillet to medium-high and add the last 1 tbsp oil. Add the scallions and toss 30 seconds, then add the dill and toss 30 to 45 seconds, just until wilted, glossy, and bright green. Turn off the heat, return the fish, and fold gently so the dill drapes over the fish. About 2 minutes.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Spoon the fish, dill, and scallions over the noodles. Scatter mint leaves, chopped cashews, and the remaining chile over each bowl; add a lime wedge. Pour nước chấm over at the table, about 2 to 3 tbsp per bowl, and toss everything together. No peanuts, no shrimp paste. About 3 minutes. kitchen_tested is false.

components.name: rice vermicelli with mint, cashews, and chile

equipment: small bowl or jar for nước chấm
recipe_version.time_clock: Prep 20 = 5 marinate + 15 herbs/cashews/nước chấm (the 15-minute marinade and the noodle water both run inside this block). Cook 17 = 6 noodles + 6 sear + 2 wilt dill + 3 assemble. No oven.
recipe_version.heat: Stovetop only. Rolling boil for noodles; medium-high, shimmering oil for the sear and the quick dill wilt. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Fish deep golden on the seared side, opaque and flaking through (145 F); dill just wilted and still vivid green; noodles tender, rinsed cool, and not clumped. kitchen_tested is false.

dietary_eligibility.nut_policy_note: Cashews are the only nut, as a required topping (HH001 cashew exception). No peanuts: the traditional peanut garnish is replaced by cashews, and the cooking oil is contracted not to be peanut oil. Cashews are contracted as plain cashews, not a mixed-nut product.
dietary_eligibility.hh001_reason: Finfish (catfish, fish sauce) is allowed for HH001. No shellfish: shrimp paste (mắm tôm) is excluded and the fish sauce is contracted anchovy-and-salt only. No dairy, no meat other than fish, no poultry. The only nut is cashew (allowed); peanuts are excluded by recipe, not by a skip-it note.

scaling_notes.1: 6 oz catfish; quarter the marinade (scant 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp ginger, 1 tbsp shallot, 1/2 clove garlic, 1 tsp fish sauce, pinch sugar); 2 oz noodles; 1 oz dill; 2 scallions; 2 tbsp cashews. Make the full nước chấm (keeps 1 week refrigerated). 8-inch skillet.
scaling_notes.2: Halve everything; a 10-inch skillet holds 12 oz fish in one layer. Nước chấm can be made whole.

coverage_contribution: Deepens Vietnamese beyond chicken pho (non-HH001). Turmeric + dill is an unused flavor system in the catalog, and fish over rice noodles is a new fish format for HH001.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with Cajun Blackened Catfish: same fish, but that is a spice-crusted fillet plate with remoulade; this is turmeric-marinated bite-size pieces with wilted dill over noodles and a lime-fish-sauce dressing. Compared with Vietnamese Chicken Pho: same cuisine, but a broth soup with chicken. Compared with Sesame Soba Noodle Bowl / Peanut Noodle Stir-Fry: plant noodle dishes with sesame/peanut sauces; this has no peanut and is fish-led. Compared with Ginger-Scallion Fish Packets: steamed packet fish, no noodles. Not a live-catalog duplicate.
